text: A simple illustration of a photorealistic shot from side view, which depicts a middle-aged man with short dark brown hair, dressed in a dark blue jacket, black trousers and a white shirt, a huge belly, a triple chin, a shaved head with drooping, bulldog-like cheeks, dumpling lips, a very flattened "boxer's" nose. He looks to be about 40 years old, he looks to the right, as if talking to an invisible interlocutor with a serious expression on his face. He holds a glass with whiskey in one hand. Background: a dimly lit restaurant hall, immersed in darkness, tables with a few visitors. dim lighting from ceiling-mounted lights, the background is immersed in darkness, which creates a gloomy atmosphere, and the image has a high resolution.
